ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hard rock fits my interests, but other albums here appeal more right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy guitars and melodic vocals fit, though I currently want something more aggressive.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The energetic riffs and melodic metal sound appeal given my interest in Chuck and Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Open Door; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The darker melodic rock sounds appealing, but it is not my first choice this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavier metal direction interests me, but I would explore the closer matches first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The rhythmic intensity and unconventional melodies suit my current interest in heavier, adventurous music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Ten Thousand Fists, I would readily try another Disturbed album for its forceful vocals and heavy grooves.
ItemID: NA; Title: Smile Empty Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic alternative rock fits my history, but I am leaning toward metal today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its mix of aggressive riffs and melodic passages strongly matches my interest in In Flames and Soilwork.
ItemID: NA; Title: Let It Enfold You; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its emo and post-hardcore direction is less appealing right now than the groove and melodic metal I want.
